text:
Emma Chen: 🎉 Huge news — we just closed 1,000,000 ARR! Mic drop. :mic_drop: Who's up for an IRL/virtual celebration?
Raj Patel: WHAAAT??!! Incredible work team :tada: :rocket:
Olivia Park: omg congrats everyone!! I'm bringing a vegan chocolate cake (labelled) if we're in-office :cake:
Marcus Li: I'll bring portable speakers & a confetti cannon (CS safety disclaimer: confetti only outside)
Ava Gomez: Can we do a 5-min shoutout at tomorrow's all-hands? Quick stories from product, infra, and sales?
Emma Chen: yes please — 2pm slot. I'll write a 60s script and ping folks to keep it short.
Raj Patel: also virtual cake emoji for remote folks? :cake::computer:
Olivia Park: absolutely. I'll drop a Calendar invite with the Zoom link and cake photo channel.
deploy-bot: :tada: Milestone badge posted to #announcements for 1,000,000 ARR (congrats team!)
Marcus Li: logistics Q: how many people in-office tomorrow? need to order pastries if >15
Emma Chen: office headcount sounds like 12 so far. If you want pastries, let's do 20 just in case.
Raj Patel: I'll handle order — which bakery? suggestions: Bluebird or Little Oven?
Ava Gomez: Little Oven is the safe play. Also can someone bring a camera for a 10s mic-drop pose?
Olivia Park: I'll bring a little instant camera and some polaroid frames :camera_with_flash:
Marcus Li: mic-drop pose = everyone jump and Emma holds a tiny mic prop :joy:
Emma Chen: plan accepted. Also, huge shoutout to infra team for that weekend deployment — saved the quarter. Raj, Marcus — thank you.
Raj Patel: team effort. big kudos to Olivia for smoothing the CS rollout too.
Olivia Park: fainting emoji. but thx!! could we get a sticker for the milestone? like a tiny 1M badge?
Ava Gomez: I'll ask design for a fun sticker pack. Maybe neon balloons and a tiny server with a party hat.
Marcus Li: RSVP thread: react with :thumbsup: if you'll be in-office, :wave: if remote but attending virtually.
Emma Chen: rapid poll in thread pls. Also remote folks — we'll send a care-package snack box if you want one (vote with :heart:).
Raj Patel: :thumbsup: (in-office)
Olivia Park: :thumbsup: (in-office)
Marcus Li: :thumbsup: (in-office)
Ava Gomez: :wave: (remote)
Emma Chen: :heart: for snack box
Raj Patel: love this. proud of everyone. mic drop rehearsal at 1:50pm tomorrow? :smile:
Olivia Park: sounds perfect. See you all and congrats again :confetti_ball:
